problem_type: Optional Markdown module rejection destroys the whole application
symptom: Controlled missing first-use Markdown resource reaches root error page and removes parent controls in actual Electron renderer
direct_cause: Shared optional Markdown wrapper uses plain React.lazy without the existing local chunk retry/error domain
class_root: Optional resource admission has Suspense loading containment but lacks error containment at the same shared owner
affected_population: Agent message, Skill detail, Prompt preview and Artifact Markdown in zh/en
Missing/corrupt chunks, transient I/O and cached failed dynamic module imports
entry_points: Four actual production Markdown consumers with cold resource hold/fault and host prop/unmount test ports

external_sources.purpose: Lazy rejects to nearest Error Boundary and caches the rejection; remount cannot reset failed module identity

invariants: NomiMarkdown stays the sole production renderer and remains absent before actual use
A rejected optional module is handled by existing local retry/error owner, preserving parent/dialog controls
Newest full typed props survive suspended load; Agent stream updates and closing/reopening remain correct
Persistent failed lazy import requires existing fresh-context reload, never a fake fallback parser

door_reduction.why_not: Four semantic consumers and shared renderer/kernel test references remain necessary; admission and error containment converge on the same wrapper.

generality_proof: Changing the one shared admission owner protects every actual Markdown consumer. The existing graph gate prevents alternate eager/bypassed imports; actual eight component/locale runtime cells independently exercise fault and lifecycle.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Use existing local chunk retry/error domain and forward the full rendering contract

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real component stream props/fault/close-reopen matrix, same wrapper
Real dialog body and host-controlled props/unmount matrix, same wrapper
Real portal content/fault lifecycle, same wrapper
Real fetch/update/cancelled fetch lifecycle and Markdown body, same wrapper

recurrence.reason: Every first-use resource rejection and future Markdown consumer can reach the same missing local error owner
same_class_scan: door-map NomiMarkdown LazyNomiMarkdown --roots=src --include-tests generated eight source doors
Actual runtime two locales times four production components; resource holds/faults, table/code/link witnesses
Reviewed existing chunkBoundary React.lazy/importWithRetry/local error/reload lifecycle before choosing reuse

prevention.invariant: Optional Markdown rejection cannot escape its local chunk error domain into RootErrorBoundary
prevention.failure_mode: Existing retries then localized explicit region error/reload action; normal rendering remains absent when unavailable
prevention.strategy: Reuse existing lazyWithChunkBoundary at the mandatory shared wrapper; retain same Suspense and fully inferred props

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the one plain lazy factory; no duplicate parser/error owner or alternate fallback is introduced

dependency_lifecycle.current: Installed React19.3.0 + Streamdown2.6.0 and native dynamic imports
dependency_lifecycle.target: Supported React/Streamdown update retaining suspended-stream and regional error contracts
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Behavior is documented and existing component domain already supplies the correct boundary; no dependency change needed
exit_criteria: Repeat controlled held/failed import, newest props/stream and close/reopen matrix at framework upgrades

migration: No persisted domain/schema/provider/concurrency migration. Existing local error/reload behavior reused.
residual_risks: Component fixtures use controlled host prop/unmount ports and loopback module faults; native navigation/provider/file permission acceptance remains separate
Real-display Mac/Windows/GPU performance and full functional checklist remain unverified
